messages:
Leah: Thanks for joining the all-hands — opening a short thread to capture the leftover Qs and the concrete follow-ups. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/jul-2026 :white_check_mark:
Tom: Quick confirmation: is the Dedicated GA still planned as a phased roll (beta -> GA) or were calling it GA for customers on the pilot list? Need clarity for partner comms.
Leah: Phased: pilot customers will be invited to an "early GA" ring with stronger guardrails; general GA still targeted for end of Q3. Ill post the ring definitions tomorrow. Owner: @Leah.
Harper: On instrumentation — will we expose per-route cost breakdowns at GA or is that a later console feature? Sales asked for that in proposals.
Sanjay: Per-route cost is in the console backlog, but we can export a simple CSV from the billing service for pilots. Ill enable CSV export for pilot tenants. ETA: 5 business days.
Vik: Security question from a customer: can Private deployment integrate with customer KMS and also rotate keys automatically? Need doc details.
Leah: Yes, Private supports customer KMS. Auto-rotation will be an opt-in workflow and documented. Owner for docs + sample: @Vik. ETA: next Wed.
Tom: Small UX ask — can we add a short "what to expect" note in the signup flow for pilot customers (limits, support channel, expected SLA)? Marketing wants this for onboarding emails.
Harper: I can draft the copy. Will drop in #marketing by EOD.
Sanjay: Ops note: were adding a canary metric set that includes tail-latency (p99.9), fallback_count, and kv_cache_warm_ms. Will feed alerts into the oncall rota.
ops-bot: Canary provisioned in eu-west-1 at 2026-07-14T08:40:00Z. Monitoring hooks installed.
Vik: Support requested a short troubleshooting FAQ for day-0: tokenization gotchas, quant-quality notifications, and fallback indicators. Can we produce a 1-pager?
Harper: Yes — Ill combine the signup note + a 1-pager Troubleshooting doc. Owner: @Harper (EOW).
Leah: Action checklist (compact):
- @Leah: publish ring definitions + early-GA criteria (tomorrow)
- @Sanjay: enable billing CSV export for pilot tenants (5bd)
- @Vik: KMS integration doc + rotation sample (next Wed)
- @Harper: signup copy + day-0 troubleshooting 1-pager (EOW)
Please @mention here when you post links so I can track. Ill send a status ping on Friday. :rocket:
